title: Definition
text: $$\cos(2\pi)$$ is the x-coordinate of the point on the circle that lies on the positive horizontal axis

title: Coordinate
text: The x-coordinate of the point on the unit circle with angle $$2\pi$$ is $$1$$.\n##figure1.gif##

figureAlts.figure1.gif: Diagram of the coordinate (cosine of 2 pi, sine of 2 pi) on the unit circle with an arrow indicating that 2 pi is one revolution around the circle.
